Derived ratings remain reconstructible from stored completion proofs; rejecting a late rating cache update does not discard the ordinary completion.
New tests exercise delayed real rating-backend opening, focus during demo, unchanged ordinary checkpoint/storage, later authorized refresh, pending result retry and ordinary/demo departure lifetime.
